hdi.prodSubtitle: Limitless Precision, Perfect Every Detail of Your Product.
hdi.desc: The CRON HDI-600S (High Definition Digital Flexo Imager) is a small-format CTP (Computer-to-Plate) machine specially designed for narrow-web applications such as label plates, stickers, cosmetic packaging, and tags. This machine is highly efficient in bridging high-quality printing needs while saving space.
hdi.adv1.title: Ultra High Quality
hdi.adv1.desc: Extraordinary resolution flexibility, from the industry standard 2400/2540 dpi upgradable to 9600 dpi.
hdi.adv2.title: SMFO Laser Technology
hdi.adv2.desc: Patented SMFO (Semi-conductor Multiple Fiber Array and Optical Imaging) technology for the laser system, allowing individual laser diode replacement (per point).
hdi.adv3.title: Tape Free
hdi.adv3.desc: CRON HDI features a high-precision External Drum with an automatic clamp system at the head and tail ends of the plate.
hdi.adv4.title: Economical & Flexible
hdi.adv4.desc: Designed to process various plate sizes, compatible with multiple print material types, from digital Flexo plates, Letterpress, Thermal Offset, to Ablative Film.
hdi.feat1.title: Automatic Plate Thickness Detection
hdi.feat1.desc: A smart sensor automatically detects plate thickness for precise laser focus adjustment without manual error risk.
hdi.feat2.title: Dust Suction Integration System
hdi.feat2.desc: Suctions carbon abrasion particles in real-time to keep the laser optical diode clean and the work environment healthy.
hdi.feat3.title: Smart Drum Vacuum Control
hdi.feat3.desc: An automatic vacuum leak sensor system that firmly locks the plate position and stops the drum if pressure drops for safety.
hdi.feat4.title: Constant Temperature Cooling
hdi.feat4.desc: A smart dual-cooling system that locks laser temperature stability within ±0.5°C tolerance to prevent overheating and extend machine life.
hdi.out1.title: Label & Sticker Plates (Narrow-Web)
hdi.out1.desc: Ultra-high resolution dot image reproduction for making roll sticker print plates, cosmetic labels, and sharp micro barcodes.
hdi.out2.title: Flexible Packaging Plates
hdi.out2.desc: High-precision polymer plate production for plastic film packaging, snack sachet bags, and standing pouch packaging.
hdi.out3.title: Letterpress & Dry Offset Plates
hdi.out3.desc: Broad compatibility for exposing metal/polyester base plates for plastic cup printing, bottle cap packaging, thick packaging, and tube industries.
